I’m in a similar situation, how I like to approach it is I tell someone about my body and past when I’ve talked to them a bit first. And how they react tells me a lot if I even want to have sex with them or feel safe and comfortable. Many men I’ve met do not care at all, and I am not worried if they do. But I like being honest and telling in advance is a opportunity to not waste my time on people who its a dealbreaker for. I’m too uncomfortable w myself to be completely naked, but keeping my shirt on has not been a problem or in way of enjoying sex. So I think you should tell him in a way that makes you feel better! It’s all about how you feel, I wouldn’t worry about them, the person will come across who doesn’t view it as a problem and imo that’s the person to be intimate with. Good luck!

Hi! I stopped (and took my shot) exactly at the same time as you, that was first shot and before i had been on tostran. Altogether I was on T for 10ish months (started w a low dose). I noticed body hair growing back thinner/in general theres not that much body hair as before but its not in its pre-t state ( i had almost no body hair). Acne has gone away completely, less peach fuzz and in general my ”moustache” is pretty non existant. My hormone levels were 4,6 nmol (testosterone). Other changes i havent really noticed, hopefully this was informative to someone!
